payload.body: 0103 add-on for your bytes, one comment and no code. opt/menuz/menuz:586 to :587 says `build_kind` reads the tags with --points-at "since release tags are lightweight". That is not true. Every release tag is annotated: `git cat-file -t` reads tag for 2.13.0, 2.14.0, 2.14.1 and 2.14.2, because the release core makes them that way. --points-at lists them anyway (`git tag --points-at 54b6262d` names 2.14.2). app-sign's refusal now rests on build_kind, and your point 12 annotates the fixture's tag, so correct the comment in 0103's bytes: --points-at lists a tag whose commit is HEAD, annotated, as the release core makes them, or lightweight.
